snippet.title: The Curse of Kubel - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
An earthquake swallows up the city of Caldesta and splits it into two. Now many adventurers travel there in search of treasure. However, a curse suddenly appears and starts infecting the adventurers. The Archwizard catches wind of this, and sends his apprentice, Magitano, to investigate.

The Curse of Kubel on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/1269810/The_Curse_of_Kubel/
